name: Illuminated normally-closed pushbutton
summary: An illuminated NC pushbutton combines a normally-closed manual contact with a lamp in the operator assembly.
description: An illuminated NC pushbutton combines a normally-closed manual contact with a lamp in the operator assembly. Contact operation and illumination can have different circuit sources.
readingNotes: Read the contact's unoperated state without assuming that illumination means it is actuated.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: A normally-closed contact function is independent of the lamp's on or off state.
